subject: Social Media
title: Black Lives Matter
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Black Lives Matter.

hook.text: A hashtag created in 2013 became a global movement by 2020. #BlackLivesMatter didn't need a headquarters.

buildup.text: Phone cameras made police violence visible. Each video went viral, building outrage that traditional media amplified.

discovery.text: BLM became the largest protest movement in U.S. history. An estimated 26 million people marched in 2020.

twist.text: But viral awareness didn't always become policy. Many proposed reforms stalled in legislatures despite public support.

climax.text: The movement shifted culture faster than law. Language, symbols, and corporate statements changed almost overnight.

punchline.text: Hashtags move minds. Legislatures move slower.

quiz.question: What was BLM's main challenge despite massive public engagement?
